briefdescription.para: Unit tests for topography_mod gfdl.climate.model.info@noaa.gov This suit includes testing for all public functions available in the topography module TODO: More intricate data with larger arrays for lat, lon, and 'zdat' should be added and included TODO: More tests to check a wider range of indices for zmean2d/1d, stdev2d/1d, ocean_mask2d/1d, ocean_frac2d/1d, ocean_mask2d/1d, water_frac2d/1d, and water_mask2d/1d.
